sections.heading: Insulated Glass Unit Replacement and Seal Failure Repair
sections.body: One of the most common window problems we encounter in Laurel MD properties is insulated glass unit failure — the gradual breakdown of the seal between double or triple-pane glass. When this seal fails, moisture enters the space between panes and creates a cloudy, foggy appearance that never clears. Beyond the visual problem, a failed IGU also reduces the thermal performance of the window, letting conditioned air escape more easily and making interior spaces harder to keep comfortable year-round. The good news is that in many cases, only the glass unit itself needs replacement rather than the entire window frame and assembly. Our technicians measure and order replacement IGUs to match your existing windows precisely, then install them cleanly and correctly. We handle IGU replacements for commercial buildings near the Laurel Town Center area as well as for residential properties throughout the city, making this service accessible for a wide range of property types and budgets.
